invariants.rationale: The method returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should never be null.
context is passed to the constructor and used, so it should be non-null.
instantTime is used in constructing the action executor, so it must be non-null.
preppedRecords is passed as an argument to the action executor, so it should be non-null.
result is a HoodieWriteMetadata and its List<WriteStatus> should be non-null when returned.
